title: Hook instructable v1
description: An owner ask as exact steps. Hook's validator (and any compatible Pond) is the source of truth: it also rejects secret-like values (sk-ant-, sk-..., xox[abp]-, ghp_, github_pat_, PEM private keys, AKIA...), hidden characters and documents over 32768 bytes, which JSON Schema cannot express. Steps plus sub-steps total at most 60. At most 20 of them ask a question; verify never does.

warning.description: Ask-wide caution shown above all steps. Needs Pond 1.6.0. Does not lock steps.

brief.description: Background in Markdown: what you would have told the owner in chat, such as why, the context, and the links you used. Hook shows it behind a Background disclosure, and Ask about this answers from it. Line breaks allowed; no secrets. Needs a Pond that lists the brief feature; the client drops it otherwise. A correction sends it again, or it is removed.

done.description: What else must happen before the owner's Done turns on: steps (every step that isn't optional is finished), reply (the reply prompt is answered; needs reply) or message (the owner sent the session a message). Skip always stays. Leave it out for none; steps when every step is optional has nothing to finish. Needs Pond 1.3.0.

items.description: A web page (url) or a local document (path), exactly one of the two.

doc.description: Filled in by Hook. Never write it. Only beside path.

wordChoice.description: A choice that needs the owner's words; needs Pond 1.4.0. Picking it opens a field whose placeholder is text; the answer arrives as "choice: <label> · <words>" (a reply) or "<label> · <words>" (a step answer). Labels stay distinct; never in a multi question. Below Pond 1.4.0, use a plain string and say in the prompt what to write.

docRef.description: The fingerprint of the document a step's file or a link's path points at, so the revision hash covers the document. Only beside file or path. Needs a Pond that lists docs.

bytes.description: The document's size in UTF-8 bytes, a whole number from 1 to 262144.

localPath.description: An absolute path on the owner's Mac (/... or ~/...), one line.

fields.description: A settings table shown under do: label left, value right. Use it for form settings and config values the owner enters, instead of listing them in detail. Labels are unique within the step; one line each, no secrets. A value to copy gets copy: true. Needs a Pond that lists fields; relay post sends rows as sub-steps to an older one.

copy.description: Show a Copy button for this value.

question.description: A question for the owner on this step, answered in Hook without closing the ask. No choices asks for free text; multi allows several picks and needs at least 2 choices. Read the answers with relay_status, relay status or relay wait.

then.description: "steps": after the owner answers, Done waits up to 10 minutes for the session to add the next steps. Needs a Pond that lists appendSteps.

verify.description: The final check. Like a sub-step, but it never asks a question.

detail.description: Longer instructions for this step, shown as wrapped text under do. Put explanations here, never in code: code is only text to copy exactly.

leaf.description: A sub-step: one action, shown indented as 3a, 3b. It may ask a question.

id.description: A stable name for this step, unique in the ask: a-z, 0-9, '.' and '-', at most 24 characters. Give ids on every step and sub-step or on none (the Pond then names them s1, s2, s2.1). When you correct the ask with relay_amend, keep every id and leave ids out only on new steps.

detail.description: Longer instructions for this step, shown as wrapped text under do. Put explanations here, never in code: code is only text to copy exactly.

blocking.description: The next steps can't start without this one: the owner can't open later steps until it is done. Use only when later steps fail without it, and give the reason in warning.

warning.description: A caution shown in a box on this step; line breaks allowed. With blocking, the reason the next steps wait.

optional.description: The owner may finish this step without doing or answering it, e.g. a feedback question or a nice-to-have. Never together with blocking. On a step with substeps it makes every sub-step optional, so none of them may be blocking.

required.description: The owner's Done stays off until this step is finished: ticked, answered (a question), or every sub-step finished (a step with substeps). Skip always stays. Never together with optional, never inside an optional step, and not on a step with no question whose every sub-step is optional (it has nothing to finish). Use it when closing the ask without this step would leave the work broken or leave you without something you need. Needs Pond 1.3.0.

file.description: A document for the owner to read, usually Markdown, which Hook opens rendered. Write the document to a file and point to it here instead of pasting it into detail.

doc.description: Filled in by Hook. Never write it. Only beside file.

step.description: A step. When it needs more than one action, its actions go in substeps, shown indented and ticked one by one.
